points.description: Names about three of the four stages of anaerobic digestion: hydrolysis, acidogenesis, acetogenesis, methanogenesis (synonyms such as acid formation, acetate formation, methane formation accepted).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for two correct stages (or one correct stage plus a vague description of the process, e.g. breakdown of organics to methane).

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) if at least three of the four stages (hydrolysis, acidogenesis, acetogenesis, methanogenesis) are given, in any wording or with clear descriptions. Give 1 mark for two correct stages or a vague but on-track description. Give 0 for wrong or unrelated answers; extra wrong remarks do not cost marks.
